messages:
Nora (Product): Quick usability takeaway: in Private setup the Network step feels busy and users think it's frozen when multiple probes show 'waiting'.
Liam (Design): Noted. My low-cost fix: collapse live probes into one summary row while they're running: '4 checks running · 9s' + a chevron to expand.
Rina (Eng): Backend detail: we currently emit per-probe events every 1-2s. We can emit a coalesced `probe_summary` event every 3s and immediate final events. That should let the UI avoid spamming updates.
Omar (Frontend): Implementation plan: collapsed summary = one aria-live polite region + elapsed timer + "View details". On expand show each probe row with a small KB link. Reserve icon space to prevent layout shifts.
Nora (Product): Copy tweaks: change verbs to be friendlier: 'Attempting SSH' -> 'Checking SSH access', 'Timed out' -> 'No response from host'. Add a leading line: "These checks may take up to 30s depending on your network."
Liam (Design): Also: timestamps are barely legible on some screens. Bump to 60% gray and minimum 12px. Allow probe descriptions to wrap instead of truncating.
A11yBot: a11y rec: use a single aria-live="polite" on the summary, throttle updates to ~1s, and only expose verbose announcements when the user expands. Ensure icons have aria-labels.
Rina (Eng): We'll add an optional `kb_id` like `SSH_EGRESS_BLOCKED` in probe payloads so UI can deep-link. Also emitting `probe_summary` in branch `probe-summary` now.
Omar (Frontend): Will prototype collapse/expand animation (200ms crossfade spinner->icon) and post Figma by Thu. Also will add "What does this mean?" CTA per expanded probe.
Nora (Product): Action items: Liam copy + contrast, Omar prototype, Rina backend events + kb_id, A11yBot suggestions applied. Target: next sprint demo.
Liam (Design): Quick Q: should collapsed summary show count of failures in real time? Might be noisy. Suggest show only when a probe completes with a non-ok state.
Rina (Eng): Possible. We'll emit `probe_summary{fail_count: N}` so frontend can show the number without per-probe updates.
Nora (Product): Great. Thanks team — should reduce support tickets for "wizard hung" reports.
